chef-s-knife.definition: A large multipurpose kitchen knife with a broad blade used by cooks for many food-preparation tasks.
chef-s-knife.exampleUsage: The chef's knife was stored safely in a knife block.

paring-knife.definition: A compact kitchen knife has a short, pointed blade for careful peeling, trimming, and shaping fruits and vegetables.
paring-knife.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Paring Knife" in an educational description.

bread-knife.definition: A knife designed to cut bread into slices without crushing it.
bread-knife.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Bread Knife" in an educational description.

cleaver.definition: A butcher's knife having a large square blade.

scissors.definition: A hand tool with two hinged blades used to cut food or packaging.

mandoline.definition: A kitchen tool with a fixed sharp blade used to slice food into thin, even pieces.
mandoline.exampleUsage: The mandoline made thin, even slices of cucumber.

sharpener.definition: Any implement that is used to make something (an edge or a point) sharper.

stock-pot.definition: A large deep cooking pot used for soups, stock, pasta, and other foods cooked in plenty of liquid.
stock-pot.exampleUsage: The stock pot was large enough for the vegetable soup.

dutch-oven.definition: A heavy cooking pot with a tight-fitting lid.

skillet.definition: A pan used for frying foods.

baking-sheet.definition: A flat metal tray used for baking food in an oven.
baking-sheet.exampleUsage: She placed the cookies on a baking sheet.

roasting-pan.definition: A deep oven-safe pan used for roasting food.
roasting-pan.exampleUsage: The vegetables cooked in a roasting pan.

griddle.definition: Cooking utensil consisting of a flat heated surface (as on top of a stove) on which food is cooked.

wooden-spoon.definition: A spoon made of wood, used to stir or serve food.

slotted-spoon.definition: A large spoon with holes or slots that let liquid drain away while lifting solid food.
slotted-spoon.exampleUsage: He used a slotted spoon to lift the vegetables from the water.

strainer.definition: A filter to retain larger pieces while smaller pieces and liquids pass through.

funnel.definition: A tool with a wide top and narrow spout for pouring liquid into a small opening.

kitchen-scale.definition: A device used to measure the weight of food or ingredients.
kitchen-scale.exampleUsage: The kitchen scale measured the flour accurately.

thermometer.exampleUsage: The thermometer was used during the activity.

timer.definition: A device that measures or signals the end of baking time.
timer.exampleUsage: The timer was used during the activity.

liquid-measure.definition: A marked container used to measure the volume of liquid ingredients.

dry-measure.definition: A cup or container used to measure dry ingredients.

teaspoon.definition: A small spoon, or a cooking measure commonly equal to 5 milliliters.

tablespoon.definition: A larger spoon, or a cooking measure commonly equal to 15 milliliters.

ounce-glass.definition: A small measuring glass marked to show liquid amounts in ounces.
ounce-glass.exampleUsage: The ounce glass helped measure a small amount of liquid.

food-processor.definition: An electric kitchen machine with blades or attachments for chopping, mixing, slicing, or processing food.
food-processor.exampleUsage: The food processor chopped the vegetables quickly.

mixer.definition: A kitchen utensil that is used for mixing foods.

rice-cooker.definition: An electric appliance designed to cook rice automatically.
rice-cooker.exampleUsage: The rice cooker switched to warm mode when the rice was ready.

slow-cooker.definition: An electric cooking pot that cooks food slowly at a low temperature over several hours.
slow-cooker.exampleUsage: The slow cooker kept the stew at a gentle temperature.

waffle-iron.definition: A kitchen appliance that bakes waffles between two hinged metal plates, whose recessed surfaces press a pattern into the cooked waffle.

juicer.definition: A device that extracts juice from fruit or vegetables.
